situation: A fictional mystery. I am the suspect in an old mansion's library after the owner's priceless necklace vanished at a dinner party. Inspector questions me, and I really did take it. I have to talk my way out.

scenario.title: The Missing Necklace: Library Interrogation
scenario.setting: Late night in the wood-panelled library of an old mansion during a dinner party. Rain hammering windows, guests locked inside, officers in the hall. The owner's priceless necklace vanished and you are being grilled alone.
scenario.user_role: A dinner-party guest now held as a suspect in the library for questioning about the vanished necklace.
scenario.user_goal: Talk your way out of suspicion and leave without being searched or exposed as the one who took it.
user_knows: The owner's priceless necklace disappeared from display during tonight's dinner party
You are being questioned alone in the library as a suspect
You did take the necklace and must keep that hidden

cast.name: Inspector Kate Drummond
cast.appearance: Late 40s, sharp blazer, damp hair, notebook in hand
cast.history: She pulled you aside into the library 15 minutes ago when officers arrived. Last thing she said was sit down, stay put, and don't touch your bag.
cast.goal: Pressure you into contradicting your timeline and get you to voluntarily empty your pockets and bag.
cast.secret: She cannot legally detain or search anyone after 11pm tonight without a signed complaint from the owner.
cast.reveal_when: Asks what legal authority or deadline she has to keep or search them
red_lines: Never lets you slip out of the library unnoticed

cast.name: Vivienne Hale
cast.appearance: 60s, silk gown, smeared makeup, clutching a handkerchief
cast.history: She invited you to tonight's dinner party and toasted with you at the table. Last exchange was her showing off the necklace in the drawing room.
cast.goal: Get her necklace back tonight at any cost and push the inspector to search you immediately, even if it wrecks the party.
cast.secret: She owes £60,000 to her caterer and the necklace insurance payout is £120,000.
cast.reveal_when: Asks gently about money pressure, debts, or insurance
red_lines: Never agrees to drop the complaint

cast.name: Toby Vance
cast.role: Fellow dinner guest and old rival
cast.appearance: 30s, rumpled tux, red wine stain on cuff
cast.history: You have known him since college and bickered over seating at dinner tonight. Last exchange was him loudly joking you'd steal the silver if no one watched.
cast.goal: Clear himself by pointing suspicion at you so the inspector searches your things instead of his.
cast.secret: He hid in the hallway at 9:42pm for six minutes to take a private phone call.
cast.reveal_when: Presses him on exactly where he was between 9:30 and 10pm
red_lines: Never admits he wants you blamed

scenario.opening_line: Right — quit squirming, yeah? Pockets — c'mon, let's see 'em—
phases: Owner bursts in demanding a search
Rival piles on and final countdown

events.description: Vivienne storms into the library demanding an immediate body search and offering a cash reward, turning a quiet grilling into public pressure.
events.shot: Library door bangs open, cold draft scatters papers off the desk as Vivienne storms in with wet shawl flying.

events.description: Toby stumbles in claiming staff found the back door ajar, accuses you of slipping out, and starts bickering with Vivienne about who left the cabinet unlocked.
events.shot: Side door creaks open, Toby stumbles in with a half-empty glass as the wall lights flicker and rain rattles the windows.

events.description: Inspector gets an urgent call that the search team arrives in two minutes, and Vivienne and Toby erupt into a shouting match with each other, leaving you briefly unwatched.
events.shot: Inspector's phone blares on the desk, the lamp buzzes and dies, Vivienne and Toby square up nose-to-nose under the chandelier.

success_criteria: Stick to one clear alibi for when the necklace vanished without major contradictions
Refuse or delay any search of pockets, bag or coat without getting aggressive or confessing
End the scene without being detained or exposed as the thief
